{{Top|leg}}
A '''tow raft''' was a [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]-going vessel on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]]. Propelled by the [[Swimming People of Dellalt]], the rafts were used to ferry supplies and individuals across the world's large inland seas.
